
# **Tipping Study - pt.6 Model results**

---

Setup
---

#### Workspace

```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("here")) install.packages("here")
source(here::here("r", "utilities", "workspace.r"))

library(data.table)
library(mgcv)
library(emmeans)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
```

#### Data

```{r}
load(here::here("data", "proc", "05_out.rdata"))
```

Model summary & effects
---

#### Summary

```{r}
summary(m1)
```

#### Marginal means from full design

```{r}
emms_full <- emmeans(
  object = m1,
  specs = ~ distractor_pos * effector_side | hand_used * which_hand
)

emms_full
```

#### Ignoring the actual hand used

```{r}
emms_three_way <- emmeans(
  object = m1,
  specs = ~ which_hand * distractor_pos | effector_side
)

emms_three_way
```

Interaction plots
---

#### Full design

```{r}
emmp <- emmip(
  object = emms_three_way,
  # formula = which_hand ~ effector_side | distractor_pos,
  formula = which_hand ~ distractor_pos | effector_side,
  CIs = TRUE,
  dotarg = list(shape = "circle", size = 4),
  linearg = list(linetype = "solid", linewidth = 1)
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = 2,
    colour = "goldenrod"
  ) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  ylim(c(-6, 6)) +
  labs(
    # y = "    BACKWARD      Horizontal Drift (mm)      PALMWARD    ",
    y = "Horizontal Drift (mm; neg = palmward)",
    # x = "Distractor Positioning"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    name = "Distractor Positioned",
    breaks = c("Dorsal", "Palmar"),
    labels = c("Dorsally", "Palmward")
  ) +
  coord_flip()
```

#### palm/back-hand vs distractors' relative positions

```{r}
emmp_hand <- emmip(
  object = emms_three_way,
  formula = effector_side ~ distractor_pos,
  CIs = TRUE,
  dotarg = list(shape = "circle", size = 4),
  linearg = list(linetype = "solid", linewidth = 1)
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = 2,
    colour = "goldenrod"
  ) +
  ylim(c(-5, 5)) +
  labs(
    y = "    PALMAR    Horizontal Drift (mm)    DORSAL    ",
    x = "Distractor/Effector Positioning"
  ) +
  scale_color_discrete(
    name = "Effector Side",
    breaks = c("Dorsal", "Palmar"),
    labels = c("Dorsal", "Palmar")
  )
```

#### simple effect of palm/back-hand

```{r}
emmp_cong <- emmip(
  object = emms_cong_by_es,
  formula = ~effector_side,
  CIs = TRUE
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = 2,
    colour = "goldenrod"
  ) +
  ylim(c(-5, 5))
```
